notes: Bible 6.2: FALSE. The sunken figurehead (3.6). Debunked by diving to the figurehead off the breakwater, or by Mags laughing at you (mags-patient-ann river-serpent-1).
text: There's a sea serpent under the breakwater. Big as a barge. Eyes like lanterns.

secondHand.text: Wendmouth lot swear there's a sea serpent under the breakwater. Big as a barge. Eyes like lanterns. I'd not go swimming.
